text:
maria_support: Hey team, incoming support ticket — customer reports rerank endpoint returning 400 for a request that used to work. They pasted the payload and it looks... off. :thinking_face:
cheng_engineer: Can you drop their original payload? 400s usually from parse errors or schema mismatch.
maria_support: Here it is (redacted ids):
```json
{
  "query": "Which hotel is closest to the airport?",
  "candidates": "[{\"id\": \"c1\", \"text\": \"Hotel A\"},{\"id\":\"c2\",\"text\":\"Hotel B\"}]"
}
```
qa_bot: This is classic: candidates is a string containing JSON rather than an array. Server JSON parser returns 200 for top-level parse but validation fails -> 400 with schema error. We log: `validation_error: candidates must be array`.
alex_prod: Customer says error message was just `400 Bad Request` with no body. They hit us from a mobile client that serializes differently.
maria_support: Repro steps from customer: (1) POST /v1/rerank with header `Content-Type: application/json` (2) body as above copied from in-app debug screen (3) gets 400.
cheng_engineer: I tried reproducing locally with their payload; our validation fails with: `candidates: expected array, got string`. Stack trace points at request.validateCandidates -> parseCandidates if typeof === 'string' -> attempts JSON.parse -> sometimes the string contains escaped quotes causing parse error.
luis_sre: Any chance this is a client-side double-encoding bug? e.g., client does `JSON.stringify(candidates)` and then includes that string in the payload.
alex_prod: Yep that's exactly what the mobile dev said — they were passing `JSON.stringify(candidates)` because they thought the SDK required that.
cheng_engineer: Quick mitigation: we should return a clearer 400 body explaining the expected shape. I can add a short validation message: `{ error: 'candidates must be an array of {id,text} objects' }`. Also we can try a tolerant parse: if candidates is a string, attempt JSON.parse and accept if it yields an array — but log and count as a compatibility warning. Thoughts?
maria_support: Customer asks for immediate workaround. Can we tell them to remove the extra stringify and send `candidates` as an array? Example of corrected body: 
```json
{
  "query": "Which hotel is closest to the airport?",
  "candidates": [
    {"id": "c1", "text": "Hotel A"},
    {"id": "c2", "text": "Hotel B"}
  ]
}
```
cheng_engineer: Yes that's the recommended fix. Also note other complaints: if candidates is `[]` (empty array) we return 400 because rerank needs at least 1 candidate; we should ensure the error text is explicit: `candidates cannot be empty`.
deploy_bot: Deploy scheduled: add validation message -> staging rollout at 2025-06-03T18:00Z.
qa_bot: I ran unit tests against both cases (stringified candidates, empty array, null) and added tests. Quick patch passes locally.
luis_sre: Operational note: customer request id `req_9ab3` showed 7s latency before the 400; that's the time the parser spent trying to JSON.parse a malformed string. If we short-circuit earlier we save CPU on busy hosts.
alex_prod: For transparency, I'll reply to the customer with the exact repro + corrected payload + guidance: (1) stop stringifying arrays, (2) ensure `candidates` is non-empty, (3) each candidate must have `id` and `text` as strings. Also offer to check their logs if they share request-id.
maria_support: Draft reply to customer: "Thanks — the 400 is caused by candidates being sent as a stringified JSON rather than an array. Please send `candidates` as an array of objects. Example attached. If you prefer, share a request-id and we can confirm. We're also rolling a small change to surface clearer validation errors."
cheng_engineer: I'll follow up with a small compatibility change: try JSON.parse when candidates is string AND parsed result is an array -> accept but emit a metric `rerank.accepted_stringified_candidates` and a warning in response header `X-Rerank-Warn: stringified-candidates-accepted`. This makes the migration smoother.
qa_bot: Add integration test: header assert present when we accept stringified payload.
luis_sre: Also create alert if we see >1% of requests hitting that compatibility path — that would indicate a widespread client bug.
alex_prod: Sounds good. Customer follow-up queued. @maria_support please send the suggested fix now.
maria_support: Sending now. I'll close the ticket after they confirm. :tada:
cheng_engineer: I'll open PR with the change and link it here.
deploy_bot: PR created: #4237 -> https://git.redwood.internal/pulls/4237
cheng_engineer: Link to internal repro script for on-call: 
```bash
# repro a failing request
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"q","candidates":"[{\"id\":\"x\",\"text\":\"t\"}]"}'
```
